source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of educational inequality (PDF 183).

blocks.text: Taleem ke liye internet aur digital tools ka access (pohanch) din ba din zyada zaroori hoti ja rahi hai. Jin students ke paas yeh resources (cheezein, jaise internet aur device) nahi, woh doosron se bohat peeche (disadvantage mein) hain.

Misal: COVID-19 pandemic (poori duniya mein phaili bimari) ke dauran jab Pakistan aur duniya bhar ke school online parhai par chale gaye, to kam aamdani wale khandanon ya rural (dehaati) ilaqon ke students internet ya devices na hone ki wajah se parhai mein peeche reh gaye. Is se alag alag socio-economic groups (ameer aur ghareeb, shehri aur dehaati log) ke darmiyan taleem ka faasla aur barh gaya.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 5: Digital divide taleem par kaise asar dalta hai?
blocks.explanation: (c) Digital learning resources ke access mein na-barabari paida karta hai. (Kitab ki answer key yahan (b) “koi asar nahi” deti hai, jo text ke khilaf hai.)

items: Taleemi na-barabari: internet aur devices ke baghair students peeche (COVID-19 mein online classes).
